title: 第2365章 到此为止了第2364章 海神岛
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
波塞西能看出楚风年纪不算很大，并不是她这样只是外表年轻，其实已经活了很久。
那么一个年轻人……
又能有多强？
她虽然常年居住在海神岛，几乎没怎么去过斗罗大陆，却也知道魂师想成为封号斗罗，哪怕是超级天才也差不多要四十岁。
往后的每一级魂力，都要数年乃至十数年的积累。
而普通的封号斗罗，和她之间又是云泥之别。
所以她不知面前的外来者，到底是哪里来的自信。
‘大陆魂师且知道神只考核……是武魂殿的人吗？’
波塞西心中思绪闪过，她选择拿下这个潜入者亲自审问。
嗤！
随着令人心惊胆颤的魂力压迫传开，一道充满神性的虚影浮现在波塞西身后。
神赐武魂·海神！
与此同时，一道道魂环浮现，环绕波塞西缓缓律动着。
黑、黑、黑、黑、黑、黑、黑、黑、红！
波塞西虽然没能开启海神九考，却也通过了海神八考，其中的考核奖励就有提升已有魂环年限，所以她最低的魂环也是黑色万年魂环。
和波塞西魂力一同升起的还有楚风的魂力，他几乎是和波塞西同时开启武魂，只是魂环比波塞西少了许多。
红、红、红！
“魂尊？三个十万年魂环？”
看清环绕楚风律动的魂环后，波塞西双眸一缩，难以抑制地露出了惊愕与荒谬之色。
常识告诉她，世上不可能存在第一个魂环就是十万年魂环的魂师，因为零环魂师就算再怎么锻炼身体，也无法承受吸收十万年魂环带来的庞大压力，只有爆体一个结果。

可眼前的这一幕，着实颠覆了波塞西的常识，同样打破了魂师界不知多少年来形成的规则。
不过波塞西好歹也是绝世斗罗，身为海神大祭司的她，知道的信息也远超寻常魂师，所以她几乎一秒就猜到了答案。
潜入者没有神只传承印记，所以不可能是通过神只考核提升的魂环年限，那么……
‘双生武魂？第二武魂只吸收十万年魂环？’
感受着楚风那并不算浩瀚，却似乎比她的魂力更强的魂力，波塞西觉得自己猜测没错。
这位实力与年龄严重不符的妖孽魂师……同样是一位绝世斗罗。
只是不知为何，对方的魂力总量少的可怜，似乎和一个巅峰魂尊差不多。
‘因为某些缘故，他的魂力消耗过大，还没有恢复过来？’
波塞西心中念头一闪即逝，她虽然惊愕于楚风的实力，却没有耽搁时间，就在她释放武魂的第三秒，她的轻喝声已经响起：
“海神领域！”
“第七魂技·武魂真身！”
汹涌的海神领域以波塞西为核心扩散，她背后的海神武魂也在这一瞬变得无比庞大，那股神性的压迫感骤增。
content_en:
Bo Saixi could tell that Chu Feng was not very old. She was not just young in appearance, but she had actually lived for a long time.
Such a young man...
How strong can it be?
Although she has lived on Poseidon Island all year round and has rarely been to Douluo Continent, she also knows that if a soul master wants to become a titled Douluo, even a super genius must be almost forty years old.
Each level of soul power in the future will take several years or even ten years to accumulate.
And there was a huge difference between ordinary titled Douluo and her.
So she didn't know where the outsider in front of her got the confidence.
‘Do you know that the Mainland Soul Master is a member of the Spirit Hall’s Divine Examination? ’
Thoughts flashed through Bo Saixi's mind, and she chose to capture the infiltrator and interrogate him personally.
laugh!
As the frightening soul power pressure spread, a shadow full of divinity appeared behind Bo Saixi.
God-given martial spirit·Poseidon!
At the same time, soul rings appeared one after another, slowly beating around Bo Saixi.
Black, black, black, black, black, black, black, black, red!
Although Bo Saixi failed to start the Ninth Poseidon Exam, she passed the Eight Poseidon Exam. The reward for the examination was to increase the number of years of her existing soul ring, so her lowest soul ring was also a black ten-thousand-year soul ring.
Along with Bo Saixi's soul power, Chu Feng's soul power also rose. He activated his martial soul almost at the same time as Bo Saixi, but his soul rings were much less than Bo Saixi's.
Red, red, red!
"Soul Lord? Three hundred thousand year soul rings?"
After seeing clearly the soul ring that was surrounding Chu Feng, Bo Saixi's eyes shrank, showing a look of shock and absurdity that could not be suppressed.
Common sense told her that there could be no soul master in the world whose first soul ring was a hundred thousand year soul ring, because no matter how much he trained his body, a zero-ring soul master would not be able to withstand the huge pressure brought about by absorbing a hundred thousand year soul ring, and would only end up exploding his body.
But the scene in front of him really overturned Bo Saixi's common sense, and also broke the rules of the soul master world that had been formed for countless years.
But Bo Saixi is also a peerless Douluo after all. As the high priest of Poseidon, she also knows far more information than ordinary soul masters, so she guessed the answer in almost a second.
The infiltrator does not have the inheritance mark of a god, so it cannot be the soul ring age that has been improved through the test of a god, so...
‘Twin martial souls? The second martial soul only absorbs a hundred thousand year soul ring? ’
Feeling that Chu Feng's soul power was not vast, but seemed to be stronger than hers, Bo Saixi felt that her guess was correct.
This evil soul master whose strength is seriously inconsistent with his age... is also a peerless Douluo.
It's just that for some reason, the opponent's total soul power is pitifully small, and seems to be about the same as a peak soul master.
‘For some reason, his soul power was consumed too much and he hasn’t recovered yet? ’
The thought in Bo Saixi's mind flashed away. Although she was shocked by Chu Feng's strength, she did not waste time. Just at the third second after she released her martial spirit, her soft drink sounded:
"Poseidon Realm!"
"Seventh Soul Skill: Martial Soul True Body!"
The turbulent Poseidon Domain spread with Bo Saixi as its core, and the Poseidon Martial Spirit behind her also became extremely large at this moment, and the sense of divine oppression increased suddenly.
